postTitle: Windfalls: Bonuses, Inheritances, and Sale Proceeds
topic: A one off windfall can turn into a permanent monthly cost

assumptions.notes: €400 a month = €4,800 a year. €50,000 / 4,800 = 10.4 years (about 10 years 5 months). Windfall line held flat at €50,000; upgrade line = total paid so far. Before growth, tax or inflation. Illustrative.
